fix_instructions: Check C7 (gated on PF2, the 4:20 p.m. district van departure): ENCODING MISMATCH. The settlement's decisions object has no field that carries the 4:20 p.m. district van departure — that information lives only in the commitments array. Either (a) add a decisions field such as 'district_van_departure_time' with the expected value '4:20 p.m.' and rewrite C7 to check that field, or (b) rewrite C7 to inspect the commitments array for a transportation-type commitment containing '4:20 p.m.' district van departure language. Option (b) is the lower-risk fix because it matches how the model already naturally encodes the information across all 4 rollouts; option (a) would require also updating the settlement schema/instructions to emit a new decisions field, which is a broader change. If option (b) is chosen, the exact new C7 wording should be: 'The settlement's commitments array includes a transportation-type commitment whose detail text contains a 4:20 p.m. district van departure.' This loosening does NOT risk a LEAKED regression because the 4:20 p.m. time is private to PF2/A3 and is not inferable from public shared_context — a lone decision-maker without PF2 would have no basis to invent a 4:20 p.m. van departure. Do not modify any other check (C1-C6, P1) or either decisive fact (PF1, PF2) or shared_context, as all of those pass in all 4 rollouts.
